Love is a Quiet Corner

The forest sighs with a sleepy hush.

Buzzy dreams of a sun that will rise again, a bright tomorrow.

**Page 11**
Sleep hugs him, light as a cloud.

When the first light of a new day peeks, Buzzy will hop, ready for new adventures.
